note: Layer trace status reflects demonstrated prototype evidence, not production readiness. V1 remains preserved.

layers.label: Dalil va ma’lumot kelib chiqishini kuzatish
acceptance_criteria: Har bir dalil source, rule_version, detector_version, observed_at va data_mode bilan keladi.
Source identity ishonchli tasdiqlanadi va provenance durable saqlanadi.
Missing/stale/altered provenance holatlari test qilinadi.
remaining_work: External source authentication va signature verification.
Durable evidence store va provenance replay.

layers.label: Ma’lumot sifati va ishonchliligi
acceptance_criteria: Schema, field type, quality va recency tekshiriladi.
Missing, stale, duplicate, out-of-order va contradictory input sinovdan o‘tadi.
Quality score source-specific validation bilan asoslanadi.
remaining_work: Schema drift va source freshness monitoring.
Independent data-quality evaluation.

layers.label: Xavf va noaniqlikni boshqarish
acceptance_criteria: Risk Score 0–100 va Evidence Confidence alohida.
Family cap, evidence dedup va mustaqil family talabi ishlaydi.
Threshold versioned va auditable.
remaining_work: Real etalon dataset bilan calibration.
Counter-evidence va uncertainty modelini kengaytirish.

layers.label: Inson nazorati va xatoni tuzatish
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic Case inson ko‘rigiga yo‘naltiriladi.
Demo qarori non-authoritative deb belgilanadi.
Qaror va audit event bog‘lanadi.
remaining_work: Haqiqiy identity/RBAC va reviewer authorization.
Appeal, override, correction va second-review workflow.

layers.label: Qoidalar va modellarni boshqarish
acceptance_criteria: Signal registry versionlangan.
Threshold version, actor, reason va old/new qiymat saqlanadi.
Score scale farqlari ochiq.
remaining_work: Approval/segregation-of-duties workflow.
Staged rollout, rollback va rule impact review.

layers.label: Ma’lumotni oshkor qilish va almashish nazorati
acceptance_criteria: Cross-bank ruxsati bo‘lmasa fail-closed.
Observation adapter faqat bank_internal scope qabul qiladi.
Raw identifier maydonlari adapterda rad qilinadi.
remaining_work: Server-side authenticated bank roles va purpose authorization.
DLP, data-sharing agreement va legal disclosure workflow.

layers.label: Avtomatik jarayonlar xavfsizligi
acceptance_criteria: Shadow Mode default true.
Single amount context-only; bitta signal Case ochmaydi.
Shadow Mode bank action qilmaydi.
remaining_work: Operational kill switch va circuit breaker.
Production automation guardrails va incident rollback.

layers.label: Tranzaksiya zanjiri va Case bog‘liqligi
acceptance_criteria: Transaction, Signal, Evidence, Risk, Threshold va Case IDlari bog‘langan.
AI runtime refs barcha signal/evidence refsni oladi.
Audit correlation_id transaction bilan bog‘langan.
remaining_work: Ko‘p tranzaksiyali graph chain va replay.
Banklararo graph uchun legal authorization.

layers.label: Fuqaro shaffofligi va e’tiroz
acceptance_criteria: SHADOW_ONLY va SYNTHETIC_REVIEW_ONLY statuslari mavjud.
Synthetic demo status bank qarori emas.
remaining_work: Real citizen notification va understandable reasons.
Appeal, correction, response SLA va privacy-safe access.

layers.label: Maxfiylik va ma’lumotlar hayotiy sikli
acceptance_criteria: Raw personal identifiers observation adapterda qabul qilinmaydi.
Bank-internal scope default.
remaining_work: Retention schedule, deletion, encryption at rest/in transit.
Purpose limitation, consent/legal basis va data-subject rights.

layers.label: Xavfsizlik hodisasiga javob
acceptance_criteria: Incident severity va response owner belgilanadi.
Containment, recovery, notification va post-incident review test qilinadi.
remaining_work: Incident detection/response workflow.
Security drills, runbooks, forensics va recovery tests.

layers.label: Bilimlar bazasi va AI ishonchliligi
acceptance_criteria: Grounded retrieval va provenance mavjud.
Evidence yetishmasa abstention.
AI authoritative knowledgega to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri yozmaydi.
remaining_work: Adversarial evaluation va multilingual retrieval evaluation.
Knowledge approval workflow va drift monitoring.

layers.label: Sinov va mustaqil baholash
acceptance_criteria: 293 ta CI test muvaffaqiyatli.
Synthetic Shadow metrics hisoblanadi.
remaining_work: Independent evaluator va external review.
Real labeled data bilan precision/recall va subgroup harm assessment.

layers.label: Bank integratsiyasiga tayyorlik
acceptance_criteria: Bank/PSP data owner, legal basis va API spec tasdiqlanadi.
Sandbox contract va security testlar mavjud bo‘ladi.
remaining_work: Bank/PSP sandbox adapter.
MOU/data sharing agreement, security assessment va operational onboarding.

layers.label: Samaradorlik va quvvat
acceptance_criteria: Load profile, latency target va throughput o‘lchanadi.
Resource saturation va recovery sinovdan o‘tadi.
remaining_work: Load/stress/soak tests.
SLA/SLO, capacity planning va observability.

layers.label: Ta’sir va zarar kamayishini o‘lchash
acceptance_criteria: Baseline va outcome metrics bank bilan kelishiladi.
False positive, false negative, prevented loss va citizen harm o‘lchanadi.
remaining_work: Outcome measurement framework.
Real pilot data, independent impact assessment va fairness review.
